faqs.q: Do you need a permit for commercial roof installation in West Orange, NJ?

runs.v: Yes. A commercial roof installation requires a construction permit under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7, because the ordinary-maintenance exemption for a detached one- or two-family home does not extend to a commercial building, per the NJ Uniform Construction Code. Do you need a permit to replace a roof in New Jersey? Not on a detached one- or two-family house; on a commercial, multi-family, or attached building, yes once work exceeds 25% of the roof area within 12 months, which is the 25% rule for roofing in New Jersey. The Rehabilitation Subcode, N.J.A.C. 5:23-6.4, requires full tear-off when the roof is water-soaked or already carries 2 or more layers; confirm application details with the West Orange construction office.
